name: Luxumbra Chronicles
source:
Chandler, Prince of Ebonreach, having ended a recent war with the Solaran tribes of the eastern deserts is seeking an alliance with the magical country Mystria in the north, who helped him win the war. He returns home to rumors and hostile attitudes and a dark plot working against him. Work to uncover the truth of what is going on.

[From [url=http://www.luxumbrachronicles.com/main/index.php/information]official site[/url]]
translation:
埃本瑞奇王子钱德勒结束了与东部沙漠索拉兰部落的战争后，正在寻求与北方魔法国家米斯特里亚结盟，后者曾帮助他赢得战争。他回到家乡，却面对流言、敌意，以及针对他的黑暗阴谋。努力揭开这一切的真相吧。

[来源：[url=http://www.luxumbrachronicles.com/main/index.php/information]官方网站[/url]]
